name: Chicken Stuffed Portobellos with Blue Cheese & Apple-Pecan Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 caps portobello mushrooms
9 sticks celery
3 Granny Smith apples

instructions.primary_message: Remove stems from portobello mushrooms and carefully scrape out the gills. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, rub with oil, then season with salt and pepper on both sides; arrange cap-side up.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place mushrooms in the oven and broil until starting to soften, 6-7 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
0.68 kg ground chicken
¾ tsp thyme, dried
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the chicken is cooking, place additional oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using tongs, carefully flip the mushrooms, cap-side down. Fill with chicken mixture and top with blue cheese.
Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to broil until the mushrooms are soft and cheese is melted, 5-6 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim and thinly slice celery crosswise. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice apples. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop pecans, add to the bowl, and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide stuffed mushrooms and salad between plates. Enjoy!
